title: Support Operations
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Open tickets
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.status IN ('open', 'pending')

kpis.label: Opened in the last 7 days
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts > DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Average first response, minutes
kpis.sql: SELECT round(avg(date_diff('minute', t.opened_ts, t.first_response_ts)), 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.first_response_ts IS NOT NULL

kpis.label: SLA met %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN NOT t.sla_breached THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true

kpis.label: Open tickets
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.priority IN ('urgent') AND t.status IN ('open', 'pending')

kpis.label: Opened in the last 7 days
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.priority IN ('urgent') AND t.opened_ts > DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Average first response, minutes

kpis.label: SLA met %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN NOT t.sla_breached THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.priority IN ('urgent')

kpis.label: Open tickets

kpis.label: SLA met %

density.bucket: weekday x hour cell, on average
density.rule: a weekday x hour heatmap needs 50 per cell on average
density.sql: SELECT round(count(*) / 168.0, 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true
SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.support_tickets t WHERE true AND t.opened_ts >= DATE '2024-01-08' AND t.opened_ts < DATE '2026-09-28' GROUP BY date_trunc('week', t.opened_ts))
